title: Switching tracking off hides Min and Max but keeps the bin section
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click the switch again.
  4. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window opens with the switch on, Min and Max under it, and an Inventory section at the bottom holding one bin row (the location's default bin, Quantity 0, marked Default) and "Add Bin Location".

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off (grey) and no confirmation or message appears.
  • The Min and Max fields are gone; Tags now follows the switch directly.
  • The Inventory section is still shown, with its bin row and "Add Bin Location".

Step 3:

  • The switch is on again and the Min and Max fields are back.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R5: “When the switch is off, Min and Max are hidden.”
  • S4-R6: “When the switch is off, the bin location section stays visible and is optional. A bin can be set as a shelf reference without being required to save.”
  • Story 4, context note: “Context note: in the dialog a new part always starts with the location's default bin, and the last bin and the default bin cannot be removed, so S4-N1 and S4-N2 come from requests made outside the dialog.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.6 Branch: a new part with tracking off". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-06-p1-6-untracked.png

The design's own words:

  • “With the switch off, Min and Max are hidden (S4-R5). The bin location section stays visible and is optional, so a bin can be set as a shelf reference (S4-R6). Creating a part with tracking off needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission (S8-R7). Editing other fields of a part that is already untracked needs the same access as editing a tracked part (S8-N1a).”
